# Tasks 2–3 Implementation Report

## Status

Implemented and committed the complete semantic AIDA portfolio page, visual system, Cube Unicorn boundary, and GSAP motion boundary.

Commit: `da313c0` (`feat: build cinematic portfolio experience`)

## Files changed

- `app/layout.tsx`
  - Added the exact approved metadata.
  - Replaced Geist Sans with Outfit and retained Geist Mono for taxonomy.
- `app/globals.css`
  - Replaced starter styles with the approved monochrome/pastel tokens and responsive editorial system.
  - Added 24px panels, 50px pill controls, focus treatment, reduced-motion rules, edge-to-edge mobile blocks, the bento/accordion/stack layouts, and the static cube fallback.
- `app/page.tsx`
  - Added the semantic navigation, cinematic hero, capability marquee, exact featured-project bento, inline typography images, horizontal project accordion, stacked project stories, hidden-only testimonial structure, hiring CTA, and footer.
  - Added stable `work`, `about`, and `contact` IDs.
- `components/cube-unicorn.tsx`
  - Added the client-only local Unicorn scene wrapper with the pinned SDK URL.
  - Added real WebGL capability detection, SDK `onError` handling, lazy loading, a server-visible loading fallback, and a reduced-motion static fallback.
- `components/portfolio-motion.tsx`
  - Added the narrow GSAP client boundary with scoped ScrollTrigger image scale/fade and card pinning.
  - Skips all GSAP setup when reduced motion is requested.

No test files were added or changed for Tasks 2–3. The existing Task 1 content-contract Vitest suite was run unchanged.

## Commands and results

1. `bunx vitest run`
   - Passed: 1 test file, 3 tests.
2. `bun run lint`
   - Passed: ESLint exited with status 0 and no findings.
3. `bunx tsc --noEmit`
   - Passed: TypeScript exited with status 0 and no diagnostics.
4. `bun run build`
   - Passed: Next.js 16.2.10 production build compiled successfully.
   - TypeScript completed successfully during the build.
   - `/` and `/_not-found` generated successfully; `/` is statically prerendered.
5. Production HTTP smoke check with `bun run start` and `curl http://localhost:3000/`
   - Passed: rendered HTML contained the hero H1 and the Cube Unicorn accessible label.
6. `git diff --check`
   - Passed: no whitespace errors.
7. `git diff --cached --name-only` before commit
   - Confirmed only the five Task 2/3 implementation files were staged.

## Responsive and accessibility notes

- The page root uses `max-w-full overflow-x-hidden`; animated media is clipped inside bounded containers.
- Navigation uses a native keyboard-operable `details` disclosure below tablet width and preserves a visible Hire Me action.
- The hero H1 uses the approved wide 72rem container and `clamp(3.25rem, 7vw, 6.5rem)`, reducing to approximately 42–52px on phones.
- The bento is exactly 12 columns by 2 rows at desktop: BTEB Flow 7×2 (14), AmarHisab 5×1 (5), SMD Rework Station 3×1 (3), DIY Soldering Station 2×1 (2), totaling all 24 cells. Dense flow is enabled. SMD and DIY remain consecutive and adjacent.
- Bento cards collapse in source order without horizontal scrolling. Pastel panels become edge-to-edge and lose outer radii below 768px.
- All primary controls maintain at least 44px touch height and have explicit `:focus-visible` outlines, including inverse-surface focus contrast.
- Project imagery has descriptive alt text. Inline decorative typography images use empty alt text.
- The horizontal accordion uses native `details`/`summary`, so it remains keyboard and touch operable.
- Reduced motion disables smooth scrolling/transitions/marquee movement, skips ScrollTrigger setup, and renders a static cube composition.
- The Cube wrapper checks WebGL before mounting the scene and switches to the static composition through the SDK error callback if scene loading fails.
- External destinations use safe new-tab relationships; Hire Me remains a direct email link.

## Self-review against DESIGN.md and briefs

- AIDA order is preserved: minimal navigation, cinematic centered attention hero, project/capability interest, motion-led accordions and stacked desire stories, then a high-contrast hiring action and compact monochrome footer.
- The Cube Unicorn is the first major visual, directly after the hero headline and its two CTAs.
- The exact approved color tokens, Outfit/Geist Mono pairing, large editorial scale, white-space rhythm, pill CTAs, flat color depth, and no dark-mode branch are present.
- Approved deterministic elements are represented: Cinematic Center, Horizontal Accordions, inline typography images, hidden-only empty testimonial structure, GSAP Image Scale/Fade Scroll, and Card Stacking.
- Server/client boundaries remain narrow: `app/page.tsx` stays a Server Component, while only the Unicorn wrapper and motion root are Client Components. Server-rendered children are passed through the motion boundary rather than imported into it.
- The implementation contains no unsupported metrics, testimonials, client claims, awards, Instagram, YouTube, or forbidden hero badges/stats.
- BTEB Flow is presented first; the two separate hardware projects remain adjacent.

## Concerns / residual risks

- The Unicorn scene relies on the required pinned external SDK URL, so the static fallback will be shown if that CDN is unavailable or a device cannot create WebGL.
- Validation covered static output and compilation, but no GPU-backed browser automation or pixel-diff tooling was available in this checkout; final visual calibration should be checked in a real browser at phone, tablet, desktop, reduced-motion, and WebGL-disabled settings.
- The pre-existing unstaged formatting-only changes in `lib/portfolio.ts` and `lib/portfolio.test.ts`, plus the explicitly excluded untracked files/directories, were not included in the commit.

## Repository state

No files are staged after the commit. Excluded pre-existing unstaged and untracked files remain untouched.
